author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Craft a grungy, surreal VFX composition with Jordan Jaiyeola! 🎥 In this tutorial, he'll guide you through the three key steps he used to bring his vision to life:

1️⃣ Composition - Outlining the concept and inspiration.

2️⃣ Assets & Assembly - Filming and finding assets with the Adobe Stock Panel in Premiere.

3️⃣ Editing & Motion Graphics - Compositing in After Effects: adding motion, depth, and effects before wrapping it up in Premiere with sound design.

Which part of this workflow inspires you most? Drop your thoughts below! 👇
